verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any first-party debounce, event batching, or delayed-trigger feature that collapses noisy event streams into fewer runs. Schedules start workflows at specific times, which is a different capability. Signals are message-passing primitives a developer could use to build debouncing, which is a building block rather than the feature itself. The CLI 'batch' command reports on batch operation jobs, not batching of incoming triggers.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I debounce, batch, or delay triggers so noisy event streams collapse into the runs I actually want
